findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Failure of conservative management of at least 6 weeks' duration (unless radiographs show Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 or diffuse modified Outerbridge grade III-IV changes)

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Joint Surgery
findings.quote: History of a shoulder dislocation or recurrent subluxation

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Small Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Radiographic confirmation of Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 or 4 arthritis of the tibiotalar joint OR avascular necrosis of the talus without collapse
findings.note: PacificSource's clinical-policies page names Carelon MBM Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines as its musculoskeletal criteria (Commercial and Medicare) and links this public guideline; PA reviews done by PacificSource. findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Small Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Radiographic confirmation of an elevated hallux valgus angle (HVA) (metatarsophalangeal angle greater than 15 degrees or intermetatarsal angle greater than 9 degrees)
findings.note: PacificSource's clinical-policies page names Carelon MBM Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines as its musculoskeletal criteria (Commercial and Medicare) and links this public guideline; PA reviews done by PacificSource.

findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Spine Surgery
findings.quote: Lytic spondylolisthesis or degenerative spondylolisthesis of grade greater than 1
